question: What can a participant do after accepting the expense assignment?

sections.beforeHtml: After acceptance, the shared expense becomes part of the participant`s personal trip work. Plantour creates a corresponding row in that participant`s Trip Expenses list.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip personal > Expenses for the selected trip.
Find the accepted expense in your personal trip expenses. Plantour shows assignment status text there so you can see that it came from a shared-expense assignment.
Open that personal expense when you want to review or adjust its normal expense details, such as payment method, amount, notes, or recipient.
Use the personal expense entry as part of your normal trip-cost tracking and PDF export workflow.
If you no longer want to keep responsibility for that accepted shared expense, return to Trip Shared > Expenses and clear Accepted or mark Rejected.
sections.afterHtml: The shared-expense page is where assignment is accepted or rejected. The personal Trip Expenses page is where the accepted shared cost becomes part of your own trip expense list.
